description: Sources for skills-hub. Each entry is a SKILL.md-standard skill (see https://agenticskills.io and https://agentskills.io) pulled from a public GitHub repo via the `skills` CLI (https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills). Run `npm run pull` to fetch/refresh everything listed here into skills/vendor/.

skills.note: Guidance for building/validating MCP servers. Useful when an n8n integration workflow needs a custom MCP server as its tool backend.
Used internally by this project to scaffold new custom skills under skills/custom/.
Word document generation — useful for integration workflows that produce reports/exports.
Spreadsheet generation/parsing — useful for data-export legs of n8n workflows.
PDF generation/manipulation — useful for document-output legs of n8n workflows.
Meta-skill for discovering additional skills to add to this hub over time.
